sec-1.summary: Cites this Act as the Competition and Consumer Amendment Act 2013.

sec-2.summary: Commences on the day after receiving Royal Assent.

sec-3.summary: Schedules for amendment or repeal of Acts

sch-1-sec-1.summary: Exemptions from subsection (1) based on regulations

logicApplications.summary: Exemptions based on class of representations
logicApplications.premise: The representation is in a class prescribed by the regulations
logicApplications.conclusion: No need to comply with conditions

logicApplications.premise: Subsection (1) does not apply if the representation is in a class prescribed by the regulations
logicApplications.conclusion: Exemptions are conditional on compliance with regulations

logicApplications.premise: The regulations prescribe a class of representations for which subsection (1) does not apply
logicApplications.conclusion: Exemptions are prescribed by the regulations

logicApplications.premise: Subsection (1) does not apply if the representation is in a class prescribed by the regulations
logicApplications.conclusion: Exemptions are conditional on compliance with regulations

logicApplications.summary: Compliance with regulations is necessary for exemptions
logicApplications.premise: The conditions prescribed by the regulations in relation to representations in that class have been complied with
logicApplications.conclusion: Exemptions are conditional on compliance with regulations

logicApplications.summary: No need to comply with conditions if exemptions apply
logicApplications.premise: If the representation is in a class prescribed for paragraph (a) of this subsection and subsection (1) is complied with in relation to the representation, there is no need to also comply with any conditions prescribed for paragraph (b) of this subsection
